products.prompt:
Edit this existing poker player namecard artwork. Preserve its unique style, palette, materials and premium quality, but redesign its oversized decorative frame into a restrained slim frame that leaves a large readable interior for live UI text. OUTPUT EXACTLY 2048x768 pixels, aspect ratio 8:3, one single card filling the complete canvas edge to edge, face-on flat 2D production UI asset. STRICT GEOMETRY: EVERY bright frame line, ornament, gem, illustration and visible glow MUST fit entirely within the outer 64 pixel strip of the canvas on each edge (top y=0..63, bottom y=704..767, left x=0..63, right x=1984..2047). All corner ornaments also stay within these edge strips. The central rectangle x=64..1983, y=64..703 must be opaque very dark, quiet, nearly uniform matching the theme, with only extremely subtle low-contrast texture; no bright objects anywhere inside. Typical metal rim only 12-24 px thick, little details may reach 56px, NEVER beyond 64. This is a THIN FRAME not an ornate wide picture frame. Keep small rounded outside corners radius 40px; no outer empty margins, no huge backdrop, no checkerboard. Opaque interior, transparent pixels only outside the small rounded outer corners if possible. No lettering, numbers, icons for gameplay, labels, watermark, guides or dimensions. Do not enlarge ornament to fill card height.
Precision margin: target the visible decorative band at only 32-48 pixels, with the 64 pixel boundary as absolute maximum including glows. Keep corner curls minimal and tight: no corner decoration diagonally entering the interior rectangle. Retain visual detail through tiny edge engraving, not by making the frame thicker.
Preserve the deep indigo-purple galaxy identity, silver-gold starlit frame. Represent the galaxy as fine constellations and tiny orbit lines only along the edge; remove the large luminous galaxy on right. Quiet dark midnight navy-purple interior with barely visible cosmic texture.
